name: Ray Marching Volume Rendering
definition: A real-time GPU volume rendering method using Taichi that performs ray marching through a 3D scalar field (smoke density) to compute color and transparency, supporting lighting, shadows, and refraction.
summary: Ray Marching Volume Rendering is a real-time GPU technique that visualizes 3D scalar fields by casting rays and accumulating color and opacity along the path without requiring explicit mesh extraction.
